title: EvidForge导师意见补充实验

representatives.car_evaluation: 分类、有限类别字段；按字段类型选定而非新结果
representatives.concrete: 回归、连续测量字段；按字段类型选定而非新结果

baseline: official Wangyibo321/TabClean, same local9B; author code adaptation disclosed; dev truth only
old_versions: immutable; no method optimization against formal answers
negative_results: all retained; no guarantee three positive contributions
scoring: per-case outputs all frozen before once-only independent scorer; scores never feed any method
scope: new supplemental experiments, no manuscript or GitHub mutation
no_llm: source fitting and execution zero model calls; pre-native source checkpoint permitted only if exact provenance verifies no model input
failure_policy: keep logs; execution errors block scoring until reviewed, never fill0
confidence_sensitivity_scope: base score/confidence threshold additive offset only; other guards and generated policies fixed
no_transforms_scope: candidate rule sources and codec inverse channels suppressed, same full sealed skill
no_predictive_context_scope: relearn with base predictive context absent, other-field state inputs zero, supplementary model inputs zero; explicit relations preserved

hardware.timing: paired within same hardware; do not present mixed hardware wall times as algorithmic speedups
hardware.assignment: fixed case index modulo3; no result-driven migration

projection_note: Case/dataset dispatch narrowed for the paper artifact; original full protocol is retained privately. No model, pollution, seed, metric or gate constants changed.
